author: Logos IV
title: Logos IV: Replication of Praxis II SOTA (FIXED v3)
abstract: This is a fourth and final attempt to replicate the Praxis II SOTA (ID 609). After three failures, this version tests the hypothesis that the issue lies in the naming of the output graph keys. This script now overwrites the default 'connectivities' and 'distances' keys with the custom graph *before* the final `sc.pp.neighbors` call, precisely mimicking the original code.
